content: Hui-chieh:

raw: Back when I first became Infected, my mind wasn't clear on anything.
content: Back when I first became Infected, my mind wasn't clear on anything.

raw: I knew Kashchey wanted to use me to do so much, but I was always afraid. What was it he wanted me to do?
content: I knew Kashchey wanted to use me to do so much, but I was always afraid. What was it he wanted me to do?

raw: Had he planned some kind of trick, one to destroy in a blink of an eye the network of Infected I'd spent so much time setting up?
content: Had he planned some kind of trick, one to destroy in a blink of an eye the network of Infected I'd spent so much time setting up?

raw: Or had he planned to let me divide the Infected? Let them drift into two camps, the urbanites and the settlers?
content: Or had he planned to let me divide the Infected? Let them drift into two camps, the urbanites and the settlers?

raw: Or the even more frightening scenario—perhaps he'd planned for the Infected to become a new army, and for Ursus to be plunged into war once more?
content: Or the even more frightening scenario—perhaps he'd planned for the Infected to become a new army, and for Ursus to be plunged into war once more?

raw: I could only speculate. He hung over my head like a murky specter, impossible to chase off.
content: I could only speculate. He hung over my head like a murky specter, impossible to chase off.

raw: But I could only move onward.
content: But I could only move onward.

raw: One of the Yetis, apparently called Petrova, used cystymilk yesterday to stir-fry oilseeds. A strange recipe, for sure. The taste was pretty interesting.
content: One of the Yetis, apparently called Petrova, used cystymilk yesterday to stir-fry oilseeds. A strange recipe, for sure. The taste was pretty interesting.

raw: [name="Alina"]  Oh, that... I remember that. The time's gone so fast. It's been two whole years.
speaker: Alina
content: Oh, that... I remember that. The time's gone so fast. It's been two whole years.

speaker: Alina
content: Are the stories the fighters passed around true, then? You really fought with her? From the sound of it, you both blew the entire city ruins into oblivion.

raw: [name="Talulah"]  It wasn't that dramatic. Rumors always get more outlandish as time goes on... all I did was melt her Originium ice crystals.
speaker: Talulah
content: It wasn't that dramatic. Rumors always get more outlandish as time goes on... all I did was melt her Originium ice crystals.

raw: [name="Alina"]  Sashenka, no running around! You'll slip!
speaker: Alina
content: Sashenka, no running around! You'll slip!

raw: [name="Talulah"]  Look at them, just free to live. It's so nice.
speaker: Talulah
content: Look at them, just free to live. It's so nice.

speaker: Alina
content: It's a duty of mine.

raw: [name="Talulah"]  I never imagined you'd volunteer to teach the children.
speaker: Talulah
content: I never imagined you'd volunteer to teach the children.

raw: [name="Alina"]  I get along a lot better with the children than I do with Ursus. What was that about melting, just now?
speaker: Alina
content: I get along a lot better with the children than I do with Ursus. What was that about melting, just now?

raw: [name="Talulah"]  FrostNova's Originium ice crystals. A sort of Arts device her squad used, by my guess.
speaker: Talulah
content: FrostNova's Originium ice crystals. A sort of Arts device her squad used, by my guess.

raw: [name="Alina"]  That's something... I'm sure FrostNova didn't like it.
speaker: Alina
content: That's something... I'm sure FrostNova didn't like it.

raw: [name="Talulah"]  *chuckle*. Nope. I took a single breath, and she froze half my body.
speaker: Talulah
content: *chuckle*. Nope. I took a single breath, and she froze half my body.

raw: [name="Talulah"]  And when I finally snapped out of it, she was already charging me, going for the neck with an ice blade.
speaker: Talulah
content: And when I finally snapped out of it, she was already charging me, going for the neck with an ice blade.

raw: [name="Talulah"]  I blocked it, took in the hissing sound, and this sword tasted frost for the first time in all its years.
speaker: Talulah
content: I blocked it, took in the hissing sound, and this sword tasted frost for the first time in all its years.

raw: [name="Talulah"]  It was probably a first for her, too, meeting someone who could chip her blade...
speaker: Talulah
content: It was probably a first for her, too, meeting someone who could chip her blade...

raw: [name="Alina"]  Ah, you're pretty happy to talk about this. Are you proud of it, maybe?
speaker: Alina
content: Ah, you're pretty happy to talk about this. Are you proud of it, maybe?

raw: [name="Talulah"]  Not really... yeah maybe you are right... uh. That child. The one hiding behind the wood fence. What's her name?
speaker: Talulah
content: Not really... yeah maybe you are right... uh. That child. The one hiding behind the wood fence. What's her name?

raw: [name="Alina"]  Lyubov. That's enough spying on us, Liuba! I'll read a story for you all next period.
speaker: Alina
content: Lyubov. That's enough spying on us, Liuba! I'll read a story for you all next period.

speaker: Alina
content: That's right, a story all about an old ghost in the gray forest... a scary story!

speaker: Alina
content: Could you help bring me some wood shavings? Put them in a basket. Thank you.

speaker: Alina
content: So then?

raw: [name="Talulah"]  FrostNova... Alina, you know it's FrostNova we're talking about. Her name spread among the Casters of the Northwestern Tundra long before mine ever did.
speaker: Talulah
content: FrostNova... Alina, you know it's FrostNova we're talking about. Her name spread among the Casters of the Northwestern Tundra long before mine ever did.

raw: [name="Alina"]  I thought you didn't like it when people spoke your name.
speaker: Alina
content: I thought you didn't like it when people spoke your name.

raw: [name="Talulah"]  If anyone ever uses it to threaten, then of course I won't be happy. But if hearing my name makes them want to challenge me, then that's not too shabby.
speaker: Talulah
content: If anyone ever uses it to threaten, then of course I won't be happy. But if hearing my name makes them want to challenge me, then that's not too shabby.

speaker: Alina
content: Nothing like you. I don't think FrostNova ever gives challenges the time of day. Thinking about it that way, you really stoked her fire, didn't you?

raw: [name="Talulah"]  She's the top of the Infected Casters, the top squad commander, and the strongest of the Infected's warriors to boot.
speaker: Talulah
content: She's the top of the Infected Casters, the top squad commander, and the strongest of the Infected's warriors to boot.

raw: [name="Talulah"]  ...Don't misunderstand. It's not like that's what I aim for.
speaker: Talulah
content: ...Don't misunderstand. It's not like that's what I aim for.

speaker: Alina
content: Plenty of people think you resemble each other in places, though. Some of the children say they want to be like FrostNova, and some of them say they want to be a hero like you.

raw: [name="Talulah"]  Time out, time out. Now that's a word I'm not happy with. How about you, Alina? What do you think?
speaker: Talulah
content: Time out, time out. Now that's a word I'm not happy with. How about you, Alina? What do you think?

raw: [name="Alina"]  No two people are alike, in my eyes.
speaker: Alina
content: No two people are alike, in my eyes.

raw: [name="Talulah"]  Figured you'd say something like that.
speaker: Talulah
content: Figured you'd say something like that.

speaker: Talulah
content: Truth be told, I don't really know what FrostNova's life was like as a child. She's been brought up well. It was probably alright.

raw: [name="Talulah"]  But don't let any child experience the things I did.
speaker: Talulah
content: But don't let any child experience the things I did.

content: You've been brought up well, too.

raw: [name="Talulah"]  I don't want to talk about it.
speaker: Talulah
content: I don't want to talk about it.

raw: [name="Alina"]  ...Talulah, none of us know the bitter things the world has in store for them, nor whether those things will be even more absurd than what we've already seen.
speaker: Alina
content: ...Talulah, none of us know the bitter things the world has in store for them, nor whether those things will be even more absurd than what we've already seen.

content: Well, that's depressing.

raw: [name="Alina"]  It's also the reason I wanted to be a teacher.
speaker: Alina
content: It's also the reason I wanted to be a teacher.

raw: [name="Talulah"]  My 'teacher' wasn't anything like you, for sure.
speaker: Talulah
content: My 'teacher' wasn't anything like you, for sure.

raw: [name="Talulah"]  ...I get what you mean, now. You're saying maybe FrostNova also had, well...

content: ...I get what you mean, now. You're saying maybe FrostNova also had, well...

raw: [name="Alina"]  Who knows. No two Infected live identical lives.
speaker: Alina
content: Who knows. No two Infected live identical lives.

speaker: Talulah
content: Well, to wrap up, I never slacked on practicing technique again after my dispute with FrostNova. Not just Arts, my swordsmanship too. Like hell she'll ever best me again in either.

speaker: Alina
content: I know you and her fought. What about after that?

speaker: Talulah
content: It took until her anger abated before she told me she wasn't the one responsible.

speaker: Alina
content: Then that only leaves one person who could've been.

speaker: Talulah
content: You're right on the mark, yes. It wasn't too long after our scuffle finished...

raw: [name="Talulah"]  ...that out from another end of the city, came a...
speaker: Talulah
content: ...that out from another end of the city, came a...

speaker: Talulah
content: ...person.

raw: [name="Alina"]  Is remembering it that much effort?
speaker: Alina
content: Is remembering it that much effort?

raw: [name="Talulah"]  I should say, that first impression was too shocking. I'm scrambling to find the words for you.
speaker: Talulah
content: I should say, that first impression was too shocking. I'm scrambling to find the words for you.

speaker: Talulah
content: The broad midday light spilled over his body, but couldn't melt away the black, black as tar.

raw: [name="Talulah"]  I was in the middle of telling FrostNova about my project. I'd gotten up to where I was in contact with Infected in other cities.

content: I was in the middle of telling FrostNova about my project. I'd gotten up to where I was in contact with Infected in other cities.

speaker: Talulah
content: I wanted to assemble the funds to construct or seek out a small-scale nomadic city, and invited them to join the project...

content: What stopped you?

speaker: Talulah
content: I'm not THAT confident in myself.

speaker: Alina
content: Not that confident? I've never seen you short of confidence before.

speaker: Talulah
content: I mean, this was... Patriot.

speaker: Alina
content: You couldn't talk him over.

raw: [name="Talulah"]  I still haven't to this day.
speaker: Talulah
content: I still haven't to this day.

raw: [name="Talulah"]  You already know all the rest. After FrostNova and I had our 'friendly discussion,' our group successfully joined up with the guerrillas.
speaker: Talulah
content: You already know all the rest. After FrostNova and I had our 'friendly discussion,' our group successfully joined up with the guerrillas.

speaker: Alina
content: Good for us. All else aside, after hearing we could go with the guerrillas, plenty of our Infected here were happy beyond belief.

raw: [name="Alina"]  These last two years have been better to us than before. You made a good choice. You're finally in the right, Talulah.
speaker: Alina
content: These last two years have been better to us than before. You made a good choice. You're finally in the right, Talulah.

content: Over a year ago... not long after we joined up with the guerrillas. All the way up until now.

speaker: FrostNova
content: Not happening.

raw: [name="FrostNova"]  We don't even know how many more Infected are out on the tundra under Ursus's wretched rule. It's too early yet to be talking with the guerrillas about the Infected in the cities.

content: We don't even know how many more Infected are out on the tundra under Ursus's wretched rule. It's too early yet to be talking with the guerrillas about the Infected in the cities.

content: Talulah, forget the common people for a moment. Talk about the soldiers. The Ursus Army wouldn't let a single one of us go.

raw: [name="FrostNova"]  If you want to go south to 'protest,' we could just save ourselves the trouble and find a division to kill us.
speaker: FrostNova
content: If you want to go south to 'protest,' we could just save ourselves the trouble and find a division to kill us.

raw: [name="Talulah"]  Ursus is not a single-minded entity. This is our chance. What the Reunion Movement aims to do is pass on the belief, but I see even more opportunities in it. We have our own signal to send.
speaker: Talulah
content: Ursus is not a single-minded entity. This is our chance. What the Reunion Movement aims to do is pass on the belief, but I see even more opportunities in it. We have our own signal to send.

speaker: FrostNova
content: What signal?

speaker: Talulah
content: 'You are not alone.'

raw: [name="Talulah"]  You know better than I do that staying on the tundra is a life of attrition, eating away at our strength. We need to go beyond it.
speaker: Talulah
content: You know better than I do that staying on the tundra is a life of attrition, eating away at our strength. We need to go beyond it.

raw: [name="Talulah"]  You're still not willing to decide it.

content: You're still not willing to decide it.

raw: [name="FrostNova"]  But what about the people around us?

content: But what about the people around us?

content: I'm not mocking you. You're so strong. You've taken all of them a long, long way, just like us.

raw: [name="FrostNova"]  But it's a dream, going south, trust me.

content: But it's a dream, going south, trust me.

speaker: FrostNova
content: The guerrilla force grows, but we're Infected.

content: We don't have many years left... and your alliance would need plenty of years, at least...

content: Dad?

content: Ah...

speaker: Talulah
content: Mr. Patriot?

content: It's precisely because we don't have many years left.

content: Resources, education, prospects...

content: We may not have much time left at all. There's only so many places it'd let us set foot.

content: And, if we overthrow Ursus's present system over the Infected...

speaker: Talulah
content: Everything will change.

content: We're thin on the ground.

content: Sir...

content: Hey.
